display.purpose: Section theses in the single self-hosted Manrope voice.

title.purpose: Charts, tables, methods, and ledger modules.

label.purpose: Compact metadata, scope, state, and navigation labels.

numericRule.purpose: All KPIs, tables, chart labels, and quantitative ledgers use tabular numerals.

shadows.name: panel-low
shadows.purpose: Low resting depth for the joined executive schedule.

shadows.name: panel-hover
shadows.purpose: Inspection feedback on chart cards and the utility menu.

shadows.name: spine
shadows.purpose: Separates the fixed command spine from the evidence field.

shadows.name: drawer
shadows.purpose: Directional depth for the modal caveats drawer.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Short control, drawer, and layout state changes.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Hover, focus-adjacent, and compact control feedback.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Preserves final state while removing motion-led transitions and smooth scrolling.

layout.utilityBar: 68px sticky black bar; 64px in drawer mode
layout.workingSheet: 1600px maximum-width charcoal evidence field with 28px desktop gutters
layout.executiveSchedule: Near-black decision memo joined to four charcoal KPI cells; 13px outer radius
layout.storyStrip: Three-step horizontal evidence → implication → action register
layout.analyticalSpread: 12-column evidence grid; principal canvas 2.2fr paired with a 0.8fr action and quality ledger
layout.presentation: Spine removed, sheet expands to 1740px, evidence rail reflows beside the main canvas
layout.print: All ten sections render in order; chrome is removed; inverse surfaces become ink-safe paper

chartSemantics.redundantEncoding: Use labels, direct units, marker shapes, stripes, dots, dashed intervals, and legends so color is never the only carrier.
chartSemantics.evidenceContract: Every placement retains title, subtitle, source dataset, direct units, accessible summary, visible caveat, CSV download, and explicit Data/Chart alternative.

responsiveBehavior.at1120: Executive schedule and main analytical spread stack.
responsiveBehavior.at900: Navigation becomes a modal slide-in drawer; chart pairs stack.
responsiveBehavior.at680: Story strip becomes one vertically ruled panel; ledgers and secondary grids stack.
responsiveBehavior.at520: Export, print, presentation, and reset move into overflow; exposed actions become at least 44px; gutters reduce to 12px.
responsiveBehavior.contentPreservation: All modes retain section order, chart metadata, caveats, tables, downloads, and analytical denominators.

accessibility.focus: 2px white outline with 2px offset plus a 5px crimson outer ring.
accessibility.mobileNav: Modal semantics, inert and aria-hidden background, scroll lock, focus trap, Escape/backdrop dismissal, and trigger-focus restoration.
accessibility.caveatsDrawer: Modal semantics, focus containment, Escape dismissal, and trigger-focus restoration.
accessibility.charts: Accessible summaries and captioned data alternatives remain adjacent to every chart.
accessibility.targets: Interactive actions are at least 44px at 520px and below.
accessibility.motion: prefers-reduced-motion disables smooth scrolling and collapses animation/transition durations.
accessibility.print: All sections print in source order with navigation and utility chrome removed.

componentPatterns: Joined executive schedule: one black memo plus four ruled charcoal KPI cells.
Responsive evidence strip: horizontal on desktop and vertically ruled on narrow screens.
Asymmetric command canvas: large analytical field plus action queue and quality tape.
Evidence chart card: heading, Data/Chart toggle, download, visual, accessible summary, caveat, and explanation.
Sortable ledger table: sticky header, tabular numerals, right-aligned quantities, alternating rows, horizontal containment.
Narrow-mobile overflow: one 44px trigger consolidates non-primary utilities.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The strongest explicit action on the evidence field.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 38px; padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid var(--blue, #e12636); border-radius: 8px; color: #fff; background: var(--blue, #e12636); font: 720 11px/1 Manrope, sans-serif; transition: background 180ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)), transform 180ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-pressed, #b70f1c); } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px var(--blue, #e12636); }

components.name: Utility Button
components.description: A compact charcoal control for export, print, caveats, and mode changes.
components.css: .ds-button-utility { min-height: 34px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #433a3b); border-radius: 8px; color: var(--ink-soft, #ded8d9); background: var(--surface, #111113); font: 670 10px/1 Manrope, sans-serif; transition: color 180ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)), background 180ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)), border-color 180ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)); } .ds-button-utility:hover { border-color: #815159; color: var(--blue-dark, #ff6672); background: var(--surface-tint, #261013); } .ds-button-utility:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px var(--blue, #e12636); } @media (max-width: 520px) { .ds-button-utility { min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; } }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: A binder-spine destination with a crimson registration mark for the current section.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { position: relative; display: flex; min-height: 35px; align-items: center; padding: 0 11px 0 13px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 7px; color: #d2c9ca; background: var(--nav, #070708); font: 620 11px/1.2 Manrope, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: color 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-nav-item:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.1); color: #fff; background: rgba(255,255,255,.055); } .ds-nav-item-active { border-color: rgba(225,38,54,.42); color: #fff; background: var(--nav-soft, #251013); } .ds-nav-item-active::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 7px auto 7px 0; width: 2px; border-radius: 0 2px 2px 0; background: #ff6672; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px var(--blue, #e12636); }

components.name: Validated Chip
components.description: A textual validation marker whose meaning survives without color.
components.css: .ds-chip-valid { display: inline-flex; min-height: 22px; width: max-content; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 0 7px; border: 1px solid #5a5253; border-radius: 5px; color: #f2eeee; background: var(--teal-soft, #242122); font: 720 9px/1 Manrope, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Evidence Chart Card
components.description: The canonical evidence frame keeps title, view control, summary, and caveat together.
components.html:
Marketing contribution

Recorded pipeline by evidence definition

Sourced and influenced credit use different populations.

Measurement caveat · descriptive evidence, not causal lift.
components.css: .ds-chart-card { padding: 17px 18px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #433a3b); border-radius: 12px; color: var(--ink, #f7f4f4); background: var(--surface, #111113); box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.24); font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; transition: border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-chart-card:hover { border-color: #815159; box-shadow: 0 18px 42px rgba(0,0,0,.48); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-chart-card header { display: flex; min-height: 50px; justify-content: space-between; gap: 14px; padding-bottom: 11px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #2d2829); } .ds-chart-card h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -.018em; } .ds-chart-card header p { margin: 5px 0 0; color: var(--muted, #aaa1a2); font-size: 11px; } .ds-chart-card button { width: 56px; height: 31px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #433a3b); border-radius: 7px; color: var(--ink-soft, #ded8d9); background: #171719; font: 670 10px/1 Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-chart-card button:hover { border-color: var(--blue, #e12636); color: var(--blue-dark, #ff6672); background: var(--surface-tint, #261013); } .ds-chart-card button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px var(--blue, #e12636); } .ds-chart-field { display: grid; gap: 12px; padding: 26px 8px 22px; } .ds-chart-field span { display: block; width: 82%; height: 14px; border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0; background: var(--blue, #e12636); } .ds-chart-field span + span { width: 58%; background: var(--teal, #f2eeee); } .ds-summary { margin: 0; padding-top: 9px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #2d2829); color: var(--body, #c2babb); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.55; } .ds-caveat { margin: 9px 0 0; padding: 8px 9px; border: 1px solid #67363c; border-radius: 7px; color: #e3a3a9; background: #29171a; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Sortable Evidence Table
components.description: A compact ruled ledger with tabular numerals and sortable headers.
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; color: var(--body, #c2babb); background: var(--surface, #111113); font: 400 10.5px/1.4 Manrope, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-table th, .ds-table td { padding: 9px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #2d2829); text-align: left; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-table th { color: var(--ink-soft, #ded8d9); background: #1f1c1d; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 720; } .ds-table th:not(:first-child), .ds-table td:not(:first-child) { text-align: right; } .ds-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) { background: #151416; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover { background: var(--surface-tint, #261013); } .ds-table button { padding: 0; border: 0; color: inherit; background: transparent; font: inherit; font-weight: inherit; } .ds-table button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px var(--blue, #e12636); }

components.name: Executive Decision Schedule
components.description: The signature opening register joins a carbon-black decision memo to a ruled KPI schedule.
components.html:

Attribution identifies where to investigate.

Total pipeline$30.2M

components.css: .ds-schedule { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(350px,1.08fr) minmax(620px,2.1fr); overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #433a3b); border-radius: 13px; background: #111113; box-shadow: 0 12px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.32); font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-memo { position: relative; padding: 22px 24px 20px; color: #fff; background: var(--nav, #070708); } .ds-memo::after { content: ""; position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 0; width: 42%; height: 2px; background: var(--blue, #e12636); } .ds-memo h2 { max-width: 20ch; margin: 0; font-size: 25px; line-height: 1.12; letter-spacing: -.035em; } .ds-memo p { margin: 12px 0 0; color: #c7bfc0; font-size: 11.5px; line-height: 1.55; } .ds-kpis { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr)); } .ds-kpis div { position: relative; display: flex; padding: 19px 17px; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; border-left: 1px solid var(--line, #2d2829); } .ds-kpis div::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: auto 17px 14px; height: 2px; background: #59232a; } .ds-kpis span { color: var(--muted, #aaa1a2); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 690; letter-spacing: .035em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-kpis strong { margin-top: 9px; color: var(--ink, #f7f4f4); font-size: 25px; font-weight: 740; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -.04em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } @media (max-width: 1120px) { .ds-schedule { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } } @media (max-width: 520px) { .ds-kpis { grid-template-columns: repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); } }

narrative.overview: The interface behaves like a black-glass executive command room crossed with an auditor's decision ledger. A fixed near-black spine holds navigation, search, archive access, and validation status; charcoal evidence planes carry an asymmetric record of ruled schedules, evidence bands, charts, ledgers, and action notes. Warm-white type supplies clarity while crimson registration marks create urgency without overpowering the evidence. The page preserves ten ordered sections, 24 chart placements backed by 21 reusable chart definitions, six sortable tables, real dashboard-data.json, chart/data parity, export, print, deep links, presentation mode, and the full-analysis archive.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black canvas with stepped charcoal evidence planes.
Asymmetric executive memo, ruled schedules, and compact evidence ledgers.
Self-hosted Manrope only, with tabular numerals throughout quantitative surfaces.
Crimson registration marks supported only by warm white, gray, oxblood, scarlet, and burgundy tones.
Dense evidence remains inspectable, accessible, printable, and traceable to source data.

rules.name: The Accountable Color Rule
rules.body: Crimson means primary evidence; graphite means validated or neutral comparison; oxblood means limitation; dark crimson means material risk; burgundy means the fourth analytical series. Reinforce every meaning with text, iconography, pattern, or shape.

rules.name: The Black Majority Rule
rules.body: Black and charcoal occupy most of every screen. White establishes hierarchy; crimson is registration and semantics, never decoration.

rules.name: The One-Voice Rule
rules.body: Do not add a serif, display face, or chart-specific font. Use Manrope's variable weight and tight spacing to separate interpretation from metadata.

rules.name: The Content-Preservation Rule
rules.body: Responsive, presentation, and print modes may reflow or focus the evidence, but must retain the ten-section order, denominators, caveats, accessible summaries, Data/Chart alternatives, downloads, and sortable tables.

rules.name: The Ruled-First Rule
rules.body: Prefer a border, shared divider, or paper-tone change before adding shadow. Never build a floating-card wall.

dos: Lead with the operating decision, then preserve the evidence → implication → action chain.
Use shared rules, asymmetric schedules, and ledgers to show relationships.
Keep all ten sections, 24 chart placements, six sortable tables, real data, deep links, export, print, presentation, and archive access intact.
Keep visible caveats, accessible chart summaries, explicit Data/Chart toggles, keyboard focus, and 44px narrow-mobile targets.
Honor reduced motion by collapsing durations, disabling smooth scroll, and preserving the final state.
donts: Do not introduce white card islands or dilute the black-primary hierarchy; use charcoal elevation and rules for separation.
Do not replace the working-paper composition with a generic KPI-card grid, use any blue/green/purple accents, add glassmorphism, decorative gradients, pill-heavy controls, or ornamental 3D.
Do not use semantic colors decoratively or make color the only carrier of meaning.
Do not hide sections, alter denominators, detach charts from caveats/data, or overstate observational evidence as causal.
Do not let presentation, mobile, or print modes remove evidence or break the original analytical order.
